top.kept: Standard cost {amount} for one piece · version {version}.
top.rough: No standard cost is kept yet: the orders count with the rough standard of its kind.
top.nowUnknown: The cost now is not known yet: inputs are missing.
top.under_one: {count} of {total} agreed prices is under the target of {target} %.
top.under_other: {count} of {total} agreed prices are under the target of {target} %.
top.allKeep_one: The agreed price keeps the target of {target} %.
top.allKeep_other: All {count} agreed prices keep the target of {target} %.
top.frozen: Revision {revision} is released: its material list and its route are frozen. A price, a rate and the other costs can change at any time.

now.title: Cost of one piece, now
now.intro: What ONE piece costs today in size {size}: the material list, the work of the route, the overhead and the other costs. It moves when a price, a minute or a rate moves.
now.failed: The cost now could not be worked out
now.empty: Nothing to cost yet: the material list or the route is empty.

how.materials_one: {count} line of the material list, with the waste
how.materials_other: {count} lines of the material list, with the waste
how.work: {minutes} minutes of the route × the cost of one minute ÷ the efficiency
how.overheadPct: {pct} % on the materials and the work: rent, power, the people who do not sew
how.overhead: A percent on the materials and the work
how.other_one: {count} line: outside work, freight, duty, packaging or commission
how.other_other: {count} lines: outside work, freight, duty, packaging, commission

now.moreLines_one: and {count} more line (under More, line by line)
now.moreLines_other: and {count} more lines (under More, line by line)

price.title: Price against cost
price.none: No customer has an agreed price for this product yet.
price.lowestUnknown: The lowest price that keeps {target} % is not known yet: the cost misses an input.
price.noGrains: Prices against costs need the price, the cost and the margin right: ask the person who keeps the roles.
price.failed: The agreed prices could not be read
price.share: The margin is a share of the PRICE, not of the cost. The target is {target} %.

keep.title: Keep the standard cost
keep.countsRough: The factory counts with the rough standard of its kind.
keep.body: The cost now is {amount}. Keep it as the standard cost: the margin of every order and of the products list reads it from now on.
keep.reasonHint: It stays with the version (only people with the cost right read it).
keep.alone: You keep it yourself: the company lets one person keep a cost (logged with the reason).
keep.fourEyes: It goes to Finance for approval: a second person approves a standard cost.

held.unknown: The cost now is not known yet: inputs are missing.
held.reason: Say why the standard cost changes.
held.noPrices: The cost now could not be read: try again.
held.noGrains: Keeping a cost here needs the price, the cost and the margin right: ask the person who keeps the roles.

done.kept: Kept: version {version}, {amount}. The orders count with it now.
done.sent: Sent for approval to Finance. The orders count with the old standard cost until it is approved.

whatif.title: What if
whatif.intro: A calculator: a change in % and a price. Nothing is saved, nothing changes.
whatif.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved. It counts with the cost now, not with the standard cost. The overhead moves with the materials and the work.
whatif.nothingSavedPartial: Nothing is saved. It counts with the cost known so far (an input is missing), not with the standard cost.

bad.pct: A percent from {min} to {max}, for example +10 or -5.

rates.title: The factory's rates
rates.subtitle: For every product · only people with the cost right see them
rates.moves: A change moves the cost now of every product. A kept standard cost stays as it is, until a new one is kept.
rates.readOnly: Only the people who keep the costing settings change these rates.
rates.perMinute: The cost of one minute of work, in each department

from.none: No rate yet: the cost misses it

rates.overheadHint: On the materials and the work: rent, power, the office. From 0 to 300.
rates.leathersWhere: Kept in Finance › Costing: a leather's yield and grades change there.
rates.oneKeeper: One person may keep a cost
rates.oneKeeperOn: On: the person who keeps a standard cost approves it too, with a reason (logged).
rates.oneKeeperOff: Off: a second person (Finance) approves every standard cost. Four eyes.
rates.failed: The rates could not be read

bad.cpm: A cost above 0, up to {max} (€ for one minute), for example 0.08.
bad.cpmFirst: Type the cost of one minute first: this department has no rate yet.

more.summary: More: the other costs step by step, the target price of a version, the size mix, the sheet line by line

refusal.TOTAL_MOVED: The cost moved meanwhile: it was read again, check it and keep it once more.
refusal.MISSING_PARTS: Parts of the cost are missing: the cost now lists what to add first.
refusal.KEPT_TODAY: A standard cost of this product was kept today already: a new one can be kept from tomorrow.
refusal.NO_APPROVER: Nobody can approve this cost yet: ask the person who keeps the roles to let a Finance role approve cost sheets.

problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not accepted: check the fields.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again.
problem.offline: The factory server is not answering: nothing was changed.
problem.unavailable: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.
